verdict.rationale: Mollie documents signed webhooks via HMAC verification (X-Mollie-Signature) and a next-gen Webhook Events API that lets developers 'retroactively inspect past events' and retrieve detailed info per triggered event, giving an audit/event-log capability. However, there is no documented automatic retry mechanism for webhook delivery, and no explicit 'replay' feature to resend a webhook event to reprocess it — idempotency keys only cover client-side API request retries, not Mollie's own webhook delivery retries. missing for 10: documented automatic webhook delivery retry policy, explicit replay/resend capability for webhook events, independent/hands-on confirmation of retry behavior.
